description: Read-only: list agents registered by this signed-in account, with exact IDs, host/version, heartbeat freshness, reported jobs/resources and model download/readiness/load evidence. Uses the existing agent:flows OAuth session; never needs fleet-admin credentials. A local-llm capability does not prove installation or inference. Older agents report unsupported model telemetry, not an empty model list. No recovery, enrollment, update or job-control authority is provided.

limit.description: Maximum agents returned, default 50; truncated reports whether more matched.

query.description: Search this account's agent ID, hostname or display name.

name: list_agents
title: List my BrandBrain agents
